note: Cast for the pre-level stand-off. All PNGs are RGBA with the figure cut out and a soft dark halo in the alpha, 1024x1536 except the American at 1145x1374. Fifty-four are drawn: the player, the nine of the first campaign, the five of the third and Malaysia, which completes the campaign, and China, Spain, Indonesia, Austria, Canada, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Argentina, Azerbaijan, Belgium, Cambodia, Colombia, Côte d'Ivoire, Cuba, Czechia, Denmark, Finland, Guatemala, Hungary, Iceland, Iran, Iraq, Kazakhstan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Lithuania, Myanmar, Nepal, New Zealand, North Korea, Norway, Pakistan, Peru, Saudi Arabia, South Korea, Sri Lanka and Sweden, each nation's one officer defending every level of theirs. The rest are placeholder silhouettes tinted in their colours until drawn — the look is specified here and the stand-off tolerates the picture being missing.

player.role: The player's commander — appears on every level, bottom-left
player.look: Four-star general, helmet with five stars, stars-and-stripes aviators, cigar, pointing finger, swagger stick in the other hand

scripts.note: The stand-off before each level: three beats, player / defender / player. All nine levels' lines are the writer's, verbatim, in src/game/cast.js.

westminster.line: Give it up you limey bastard
God save the queen, and your soul
Thank god, I was worried we dragged this ordnance across the Atlantic for nothing!

paris.line: All I heard was baguette, and that's all I need

agra.line: Nice tomb. Vacate the premises before I add to the occupancy.
Twenty thousand men built this in twenty-two years. You have four guns and a hangover.
Twenty-two years? Give me twenty-two minutes.

agra_alt.line: That's a hell of a headstone. Move it or lose it, chief.
It was built for love, sahib. You would not understand — no one has ever loved you.
Love, huh? Boys, show him how much I love a 155.

giza.line: God it's hot out here, give it up before we all melt would ya?
اطلع الهرم ده وهاتك يا طفل يا تخين
I don't speak Sanskrit habibi, but I get the gist. Someone get me some damn water and a lot of bombs

chichen.line: Step aside, chief. We do not negotiate with calendars.
Llevas mil años tarde. Esto ya lo enterramos una vez y lo volvimos a construir encima.
Built it twice, huh? Well hell, that is half my work done for me.

pisa.line: That thing is already falling over. Save us both the ammunition.
Pende da ottocento anni, americano. Tu non duri otto minuti in questo sole.
Eight hundred years of leaning. Let us call it a running start.

moscow.line: Nine churches. I brought enough for ten.
Иван ослепил зодчего, чтобы он не построил второго. Тебе глаза оставим — смотри.
I did not catch a word of that, but he sounded real confident about it.

sydney.line: You are on a point with water on three sides. Where exactly are you going?
Mate, you have got one road in and we have got the whole harbour. Take your shot.
Finally, one of them speaks English. Does not make him right.

rio.line: Seven hundred metres up with no road out. Walk down or be carried.
Ele está de braços abertos há um século. Nem por você ele abaixa.
Arms out like that? Son, that is not a welcome, that is a target.

petronas.line: Two of them. Somebody built it twice and still couldn't get it right.
Dua menara, satu jambatan. Tembak jambatan itu — ia tidak menahan apa-apa.
He's pointing at the bridge. Boys, shoot everything BUT the bridge.

potala.line: Thirteen storeys of whitewash on a red rock. Walk out and I leave the paint on it.
这堵墙比你的炮管还厚。你打的是山，不是房子。
A mountain. Great. Bring the whole catalogue, we're going to be here a while.

ur.look: Farīq Awwal as a Mesopotamian champion: a red, white and black keffiyeh wound as a turban with a gold medallion, gilded pauldrons and bracers worked with lions, scale armour over a white robe, a red, black and white skirt of woven panels and tassels, a lion buckle, the flag of Iraq with the takbir worn as a fringed cape, tall brown boots tooled with lions and palms, a curved sword in a lion scabbard, beard, arms folded

djoser.look: Mushir of Egypt in dress uniform; placeholder silhouette in the flag's colours until drawn.

yamoussoukro.defends: Basilica of Our Lady of Peace, Yamoussoukro
yamoussoukro.look: Général de corps d'armée in the ceremonial dress of a chief: an orange-and-green headdress with a gold disc and orange, white and green plumes, white clay markings on the face and arms, strings of orange, white and green beads, a leopard skin over the shoulder, gold armlets and an elephant buckle, a kente-patterned wrap and sash in the flag's colours with gold fringes, white trousers, gold elephant greaves over beaded ankles, sandals, a gold-headed spear, beard, arms folded

cntower.look: General in Mountie red serge with a black collar and gold maple leaves, a Stetson with a maple-leaf badge, gold aiguillettes and a Sam Browne belt, the maple leaf on the arm, dark breeches with a gold stripe, tall brown riding boots with spurs, a fur-trimmed cape in the flag, a sabre, moustache, cigar, arms folded

capitolio.look: General de Cuerpo de Ejército as a Sierra Maestra guerrilla: olive fatigues with rolled sleeves, a beret with the red star, a red neckerchief, bandoliers across the chest, webbing pouches and a machete on the belt, a rifle slung over the shoulder, the flag of Cuba worn torn as a cape, laced combat boots, full beard, cigar, arms folded

obelisco.look: Teniente General in a navy tunic with gold oak leaves and bullion epaulettes, a sky-blue and white sash, the Sun of May on the arm, the buckle and the boot cuffs, a navy wide-brimmed hat with blue and white plumes, the flag worn as a fringed cape with the Sun on it, tall brown boots with sun spurs, a sabre, moustache, cigar, arms folded

skytower.look: Lieutenant General as a Māori rangatira: tā moko on the face and arms, hair tied up with red, white and black feathers, a korowai cloak of black, red, white and blue feathers with a tāniko border, a woven flax piupiu and belt with pounamu and bone pendants, a hei-tiki and koru carvings, woven leg bindings, barefoot, a carved taiaha at his side, arms folded
